decisions.basis: No silent assumption or omitted-clause readiness
decisions.choice: Explicit source selectors/ranges and a total source-unit inventory; inherited prose defaults unresolved

decisions.basis: Definitions/logic first and independent evidence ceilings
decisions.choice: Schema well-formedness is separate from source correspondence, signature typing, review and proof

decisions.basis: No source-owner acceptance has been supplied
decisions.choice: Review packet includes realistic instance/counterexample and omissions; owner fidelity remains pending

scope: New interpretation schema, same-unit correspondence helper/reviewable fixture/tests and unit evidence only.

task_contract.closeout: Bind actual inputs/outputs/provider and criterion results; append project-local status; preserve prior candidate evidence.
task_contract.edge_cases: Owner sees realistic instance and counterexample; no inherited scaffold paragraph becomes an axiom by default; missing clauses/dependencies cannot count as complete.
task_contract.failure_behavior: Emit failed or explicit unresolved outcome; preserve inputs and last successful bundle. No silently skipped obligation.
task_contract.ordered_rules: Define typed signatures and canonical statements; map every normative clause, boundary and example to encoded, premise, explanatory, deferred or unresolved; declare explicit semantic dependencies and source precedence.
task_contract.pre_execution_check: Rehash declared source and upstream receipts; verify exact source/currentness, semantic closure and absent outputs. Future outputs need not exist before creation.

validation.reviewable_check: Owner sees realistic instance and counterexample; no inherited scaffold paragraph becomes an axiom by default; missing clauses/dependencies cannot count as complete.
validation.runner_state: Declared same-unit post-produce test output; no dependency on the later I04 CLI.
